entities.summary: Carl Christian Folin is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman for Frölunda HC of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Originally undrafted by teams in the National Hockey League (NHL), Folin has previously played for the Minnesota Wild, Los Angeles Kings, Philadelphia Flyers, and Montreal Canadiens.
